  1856	    /// Codex writes a separate record for every paragraph it narrates between
  1857	    /// tool calls, so counting records put roughly twenty times as many
  1858	    /// "messages" on a Codex row as on a Claude row for the same amount of
  1859	    /// conversation — and the two sit side by side on the same list. A run of
  1860	    /// them is one thing the agent said back, so it counts once.
  1861	    #[test]
  1862	    fn codex_narration_between_tool_calls_counts_as_one_agent_turn() {
  1863	        let narrated = concat!(
  1864	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:42:17.000Z","type":"session_meta","payload":{"id":"019fa964","cwd":"/Users/dev/work/rental-management","originator":"codex-tui","thread_source":"user","source":"cli"}}"#,
  1865	            "\n",
  1866	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:42:30.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Plan the 2027 simulation."}]}}"#,
  1867	            "\n",
  1868	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:43:00.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"Reading the scanner now."}]}}"#,
  1869	            "\n",
  1870	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:43:10.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"function_call","name":"shell","arguments":"{}"}}"#,
  1871	            "\n",
  1872	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:43:20.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"Now changing the reader."}]}}"#,
  1873	            "\n",
  1874	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:43:30.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"Here is the plan for 2027."}]}}"#,
  1875	        );
  1876	
  1877	        let records = parse_codex_rollout_jsonl(narrated);
  1878	
  1879	        // One thing the user typed, one thing the agent said back.
  1880	        assert_eq!(records[0].message_count, Some(2));
  1881	        assert_eq!(
  1882	            records[0].latest_turn_preview.as_deref(),
  1883	            Some("Agent: Here is the plan for 2027.")
  1884	        );
  1885	
  1886	        // A second exchange is a second pair, so the count still grows with the
  1887	        // conversation rather than with the narration.
  1888	        let second_exchange = format!(
  1889	            "{narrated}\n{}\n{}",
  1890	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:44:00.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Go ahead."}]}}"#,
  1891	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:44:10.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":"Done."}]}}"#
  1892	        );
  1893	        let records = parse_codex_rollout_jsonl(&second_exchange);
  1894	        assert_eq!(records[0].message_count, Some(4));
  1895	        assert_eq!(
  1896	            records[0].latest_turn_preview.as_deref(),
  1897	            Some("Agent: Done.")
  1898	        );
  1899	    }

  1901	    /// A rollout file is read as a window from the start and a window from the
  1902	    /// end. When the file is bigger than one window but smaller than two, those
  1903	    /// two windows OVERLAP, and every line in the overlap used to be handed to
  1904	    /// the parser twice. Nothing noticed until a row started counting turns:
  1905	    /// counting is the first thing this parser does that is not idempotent, and
  1906	    /// a session in that size band reported a number inflated by the overlap —
  1907	    /// while the same file through the web preview reported the true one.
  1908	    #[test]
  1909	    fn a_file_between_one_window_and_two_is_not_read_twice() {
  1910	        // Long enough to run past one window, short enough to stay inside two.
  1911	        let padding = "x".repeat(700);
  1912	        let mut lines = vec![
  1913	            r#"{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:42:17.000Z","type":"session_meta","payload":{"id":"019fa964","cwd":"/Users/dev/work/rental-management","originator":"codex-tui","thread_source":"user","source":"cli"}}"#
  1914	                .to_string(),
  1915	        ];
  1916	        let exchanges = 200;
  1917	        for index in 0..exchanges {
  1918	            lines.push(format!(
  1919	                r#"{{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:42:30.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{{"type":"input_text","text":"Question {index} {padding}"}}]}}}}"#
  1920	            ));
  1921	            lines.push(format!(
  1922	                r#"{{"timestamp":"2026-07-28T16:43:00.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{{"type":"output_text","text":"Answer {index} {padding}"}}]}}}}"#
  1923	            ));
  1924	        }
  1925	        let body = lines.join("\n");
  1926	
  1927	        let combined = CODEX_SESSION_HEAD_BYTES + CODEX_SESSION_TAIL_BYTES;
  1928	        assert!(
  1929	            body.len() > CODEX_SESSION_HEAD_BYTES && body.len() < combined,
  1930	            "the fixture has to land in the band where the two windows overlap; \
  1931	             it is {} bytes and the band is {}..{}",
  1932	            body.len(),
  1933	            CODEX_SESSION_HEAD_BYTES,
  1934	            combined
  1935	        );
  1936	
  1937	        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().expect("temp dir");
  1938	        let path = directory.path().join("rollout-019fa964.jsonl");
  1939	        fs::write(&path, &body).expect("write the fixture");
  1940	
  1941	        let read = read_head_and_tail_utf8(&path, CODEX_SESSION_HEAD_BYTES, CODEX_SESSION_TAIL_BYTES)
  1942	            .expect("read the fixture");
  1943	        assert_eq!(
  1944	            read.lines().count(),
  1945	            body.lines().count(),
  1946	            "the file came back with lines in it more than once"
  1947	        );
  1948	
  1949	        let records = parse_codex_rollout_jsonl(&read);
  1950	        assert_eq!(records[0].message_count, Some(exchanges * 2));
  1951	    }

  2119	    fn codex_index_rows_are_dropped_when_a_rollout_proves_them_helper_threads() {

   359	                if let (Some(record), Some(prompt)) =
   360	                    (records.last(), codex_user_prompt_text(&value))
   361	                {
   362	                    first_prompts.entry(record.id.clone()).or_insert(prompt);
   363	                }
   364	
   365	                if let Some(id) = records.last().map(|record| record.id.clone()) {
   366	                    if let Some((speaker, turn)) = codex_conversation_turn(&value) {
   367	                        // Codex writes a separate record for every paragraph it
   368	                        // narrates between tool calls, so a run of them is ONE
   369	                        // thing the agent said back, not twenty. Without this a
   370	                        // Codex row read "691 messages" where the Claude row
   371	                        // beside it, for a longer conversation, read "33".
   372	                        let repeat_narration = speaker == CodexSpeaker::Agent
   373	                            && last_speakers.get(&id) == Some(&CodexSpeaker::Agent);
   374	                        if !repeat_narration {
   375	                            *message_counts.entry(id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
   376	                        }
   377	                        last_speakers.insert(id.clone(), speaker);
   378	                        latest_turns.insert(id, turn); // a later line is the newer turn
   379	                    }
   380	                }
   381	
   382	                let cwd = codex_response_item_workdir(&value);
   383	                let description = codex_response_item_description(&value);
   384	                if cwd.is_none() && description.is_none() {
   385	                    continue;
   386	                };
   387	                let last_activity = value
   388	                    .get("timestamp")
   389	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
   390	                    .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   391	                update_latest_codex_record(&mut records, cwd, description, None, last_activity);
   392	            }
   393	            _ => {}
   394	        }
   395	    }
   396	
   397	    for record in records.iter_mut() {
   398	        record.title = codex_display_title(
   399	            &record.title,
   400	            first_prompts.get(&record.id).map(String::as_str),
   401	        );
   402	        record.message_count = message_counts.get(&record.id).copied();
   403	        record.latest_turn_preview = latest_turns.get(&record.id).cloned();
   404	    }
   405	
   406	    records
   407	}

   409	/// Who said one message of a Codex conversation.
   410	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
   411	enum CodexSpeaker {
   412	    User,
   413	    Agent,
   414	}
   415	
   416	/// One message of a Codex conversation: who said it, and how a row would show
   417	/// it. The user side uses the same filter the title does, so the opening turns
   418	/// Codex writes for itself — the repository instructions, the environment block
   419	/// — are neither counted nor shown; the agent side needs actual words.
   420	fn codex_conversation_turn(value: &Value) -> Option<(CodexSpeaker, String)> {
   421	    let payload = value.get("payload")?;
   422	    if payload.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("message") {
   423	        return None;
   424	    }
   425	
   426	    match payload.get("role").and_then(Value::as_str)? {
   427	        "user" => Some((
   428	            CodexSpeaker::User,
   429	            agent_session_turn_preview(
   430	                AGENT_SESSION_USER_TURN_PREFIX,
   650	    let payload = value.get("payload")?;
   651	    if payload.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("message") {
   652	        return None;
   653	    }
   654	    if payload.get("role").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("user") {
   655	        return None;
   656	    }
   657	
   658	    payload
   659	        .get("content")
   660	        .and_then(value_to_text)
   661	        .map(|text| compact_text(&text, 140))
   662	}

   664	pub fn merge_codex_session_metadata(
   665	    mut indexed: Vec<AgentSessionRecord>,
   666	    metadata: Vec<AgentSessionRecord>,
   667	) -> Vec<AgentSessionRecord> {
   668	    for record in metadata {
   669	        if let Some(existing) = indexed
   670	            .iter_mut()
   671	            .find(|candidate| candidate.provider == record.provider && candidate.id == record.id)
   672	        {
   673	            merge_codex_record(existing, record);
   674	        } else {
   675	            indexed.push(record);
   676	        }
   677	    }
   678	
   679	    indexed
   680	}

   682	pub fn parse_cmux_hook_sessions_json(agent: &str, input: &str) -> Vec<AgentSessionRecord> {
   683	    let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(input) else {
   684	        return Vec::new();
   685	    };
   686	    let Some(sessions) = value.get("sessions").and_then(Value::as_object) else {
   687	        return Vec::new();
   688	    };
   689	
   690	    let agent = agent.trim().to_lowercase();
   691	    if agent.is_empty() {
   692	        return Vec::new();
   693	    }
   694	
   695	    sessions
   696	        .iter()
   697	        .filter_map(|(key, value)| {
   698	            let id = value
   699	                .get("sessionId")
   700	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
   701	                .unwrap_or(key)
   702	                .trim();
   703	            if id.is_empty() {
   704	                return None;
   705	            }
   706	
   707	            let cwd = value
   708	                .get("cwd")
   709	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
   710	                .or_else(|| {
   711	                    value
   712	                        .get("launchCommand")
   713	                        .and_then(|launch| launch.get("workingDirectory"))
   714	                        .and_then(Value::as_str)
   715	                })
   716	                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
   717	                .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   718	            let last_activity = timestampish_string(value.get("updatedAt"))
   719	                .or_else(|| timestampish_string(value.get("startedAt")))
   720	                .or_else(|| {
   721	                    timestampish_string(
   722	                        value
   723	                            .get("launchCommand")
   724	                            .and_then(|launch| launch.get("capturedAt")),
   725	                    )
   726	                });
   727	            let status = value
   728	                .get("runtimeStatus")
   729	                .and_then(Value::as_str)
   730	                .or_else(|| value.get("agentLifecycle").and_then(Value::as_str))
   731	                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
   732	            let title = cmux_session_title(&agent, value, status, cwd.as_deref());
   733	
   734	            Some(AgentSessionRecord {
   735	                provider: format!("cmux-{agent}"),
   736	                id: id.to_string(),
   737	                title,
   738	                description: cmux_session_description(value),
   739	                model: model_from_value(value),
   740	                project_path: cwd.clone(),
   741	                last_activity,
   742	                resume_commands: cmux_resume_commands(&agent, id, cwd.as_deref()),
   743	                branch_hint: None,
   744	                task_id: None,
   745	                pull_request_hint: None,
   746	                source_label: None,
   747	                message_count: None,
   748	                latest_turn_preview: None,
   749	            })
   750	        })
   751	        .collect()
   752	}

   754	pub fn parse_claude_jsonl(input: &str, project_path: &str) -> Vec<AgentSessionRecord> {
   755	    let mut records: Vec<AgentSessionRecord> = Vec::new();
   756	    let mut ai_titles: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
   757	    let mut first_prompts: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
   758	    let mut message_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();
   759	    let mut latest_turns: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
   760	
   761	    for value in input
   762	        .lines()
   763	        .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line).ok())
   764	    {
   765	        // One such entry condemns the whole transcript: these files are what
   766	        // they are end to end, so anything already collected from one is an
   767	        // agent's turn, not a session the user can resume. Both checks answer
   768	        // the same question — "is this a top-level session?" — from different
   769	        // evidence: a subagent's sidechain flag, or a helper's entrypoint.
   770	        if is_claude_sidechain_entry(&value) || is_claude_agent_launched_entry(&value) {
   771	            return Vec::new();
   772	        }
   773	
   774	        if let Some((session, title)) = claude_ai_title(&value) {
   775	            ai_titles.insert(session, title); // a later line carries the newer title
   776	        }
   777	        if let Some((session, prompt)) = claude_user_prompt_text(&value) {
   778	            first_prompts.entry(session).or_insert(prompt);
   779	        }
   780	        if let Some((session, turn)) = claude_conversation_turn(&value) {
   781	            *message_counts.entry(session.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
   782	            latest_turns.insert(session, turn); // a later line is the newer turn
   783	        }
   784	
   785	        let Some(id) = value
   786	            .get("sessionId")
   787	            .or_else(|| value.get("session_id"))
   788	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
   789	        else {
   790	            continue;
   791	        };
   792	
   793	        let timestamp = value
   794	            .get("timestamp")
   795	            .or_else(|| value.get("created_at"))
   796	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
   797	            .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   798	
   799	        let cwd = value
   800	            .get("cwd")
   801	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
   802	            .unwrap_or(project_path)
   803	            .to_string();
   804	
   805	        let title = title_from_claude_message(&value)
   806	            .unwrap_or_else(|| CLAUDE_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE.to_string());
   807	        let record = AgentSessionRecord {
   808	            provider: "claude".to_string(),
   809	            id: id.to_string(),
   810	            title,
   811	            description: claude_session_description(&value),
   812	            model: value
   813	                .get("message")
   814	                .and_then(model_from_value)
   815	                .or_else(|| model_from_value(&value)),
   816	            project_path: (!cwd.is_empty()).then_some(cwd.clone()),
   817	            last_activity: timestamp,
   818	            resume_commands: vec![
   819	                format!("claude --resume {id}"),
   820	                format!("cd {} && claude --resume {id}", shell_quote(&cwd)),
   821	            ],
   822	            branch_hint: None,
   823	            task_id: None,
   824	            pull_request_hint: None,
   825	            source_label: None,
   826	            message_count: None,
   827	            latest_turn_preview: None,
   828	        };
   829	
   830	        if let Some(existing) = records
   831	            .iter_mut()
   832	            .find(|candidate| candidate.provider == record.provider && candidate.id == record.id)
   833	        {
   834	            merge_agent_session_record(existing, record);
   835	        } else {
   836	            records.push(record);
   837	        }
   838	    }
   839	
   840	    for record in records.iter_mut() {
   841	        record.title = claude_display_title(
   842	            &record.title,
   843	            ai_titles.get(&record.id).map(String::as_str),
   844	            first_prompts.get(&record.id).map(String::as_str),
   845	            record.project_path.as_deref(),
   846	        );
   847	        record.message_count = message_counts.get(&record.id).copied();
   848	        record.latest_turn_preview = latest_turns.get(&record.id).cloned();
   849	    }
   850	
   851	    records
   852	}
   853	
   854	/// One turn of the conversation as a row counts it, and how that row would show
   855	/// it. Tool calls and tool results are `type: "user"` and `type: "assistant"`
   856	/// records too, so both sides insist on actual words: a user turn goes through
   857	/// the same filter the title uses (no slash-command wrappers, no resume
   858	/// caveat), and an assistant turn needs at least one text block.
   859	fn claude_conversation_turn(value: &Value) -> Option<(String, String)> {
   860	    match optional_string(value.get("type"))?.as_str() {
   861	        "user" => {
   862	            let (id, text) = claude_user_prompt_text(value)?;
   863	            Some((
   864	                id,
   865	                agent_session_turn_preview(AGENT_SESSION_USER_TURN_PREFIX, &text),
   866	            ))
   867	        }
   868	        "assistant" => {
   869	            let id = optional_string(value.get("sessionId"))?;
   870	            let text = claude_assistant_text(value)?;
   871	            Some((
   872	                id,
   873	                agent_session_turn_preview(AGENT_SESSION_AGENT_TURN_PREFIX, &text),
   874	            ))
   875	        }
   876	        _ => None,
   877	    }
   878	}
   879	
   880	/// What the agent said in words on one transcript line. An assistant record
   881	/// whose content is nothing but `tool_use` blocks said nothing, and yields
   882	/// `None`.
   883	fn claude_assistant_text(value: &Value) -> Option<String> {
   884	    let content = value.get("message")?.get("content")?;
   885	    let text = match content {
   886	        Value::String(text) => text.clone(),
   887	        Value::Array(items) => items
   888	            .iter()
   889	            .filter(|item| optional_string(item.get("type")).as_deref() == Some("text"))
   890	            .filter_map(|item| item.get("text").and_then(Value::as_str))
   891	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
   892	            .join(" "),
   893	        _ => return None,
   894	    };
   895	
   896	    let text = text.trim();
   897	    (!text.is_empty()).then(|| text.to_string())
   898	}

   900	/// A Claude Code SUBAGENT transcript is stored as its own `.jsonl` and is never
   901	/// resumable — `claude --resume <id>` on one is meaningless — so it must never
   902	/// reach the rail. Two independent discriminators, because each covers what the
   903	/// other cannot: the path is free and also keeps subagents out of the scan's
   904	/// file budget, the content is authoritative and still catches a flat layout.
   905	///
   906	/// Today Claude Code writes them under `<project>/<session>/subagents/`.
   907	fn is_claude_subagent_transcript_path(path: &Path) -> bool {
   908	    path.components()
   909	        .any(|component| component.as_os_str() == "subagents")
   910	}
   970	fn claude_transcript_file_is_agent_launched(path: &Path) -> bool {
   971	    let Ok(head) = read_head_utf8(path, CLAUDE_SESSION_LAUNCH_PROBE_BYTES) else {
   972	        return false;
   973	    };
   974	
   975	    claude_transcript_head_is_agent_launched(&head)
   976	}

   978	pub fn claude_transcript_head_is_agent_launched(head: &str) -> bool {
   979	    head.lines()
   980	        .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line).ok())
   981	        .any(|value| is_claude_agent_launched_entry(&value))
   982	}

   984	/// Claude Code records its own generated session title on a `type: "ai-title"`
   985	/// line. It is the best title available — it describes the whole session rather
   986	/// than whichever message happened to be last — so it wins outright.
   987	fn claude_ai_title(value: &Value) -> Option<(String, String)> {
   988	    if optional_string(value.get("type"))? != "ai-title" {
   989	        return None;
   990	    }
   991	
   992	    Some((
   993	        optional_string(value.get("sessionId"))?,
   994	        optional_string(value.get("aiTitle"))?,
   995	    ))
   996	}

   998	/// Openings that mean Claude Code wrote this "user" message, not the user. `<`
   999	/// covers every tagged block it injects (`<command-name>`,
  1000	/// `<local-command-caveat>`); the resume caveat and the interruption notice are
  1001	/// the two it writes as plain sentences.
  1002	///
  1003	/// The interruption matters more than it looks. Pressing Escape in the middle
  1004	/// of an answer is how a session usually ends, so it is disproportionately
  1005	/// likely to be the LAST thing in a transcript — and the row shows the last
  1006	/// thing said. In 617 real user turns sampled on this machine, 50 of them were
  1007	/// exactly "[Request interrupted by user]".

  1009	    &["<", "Caveat:", "[Request interrupted"];

  1011	/// The first genuine user prompt in the scanned window. Tool results are
  1012	/// `type: "user"` too, so plain `content` text is required and `tool_result`
  1013	/// items are dropped; anything Claude Code wrote for itself is skipped because
  1014	/// none of it says what the session is about.

  1016	    if optional_string(value.get("type"))? != "user" {
  1017	        return None;
  1018	    }
  1019	    if value.get("isMeta").and_then(Value::as_bool) == Some(true) {
  1020	        return None;
  1021	    }
  1022	
  1023	    let id = optional_string(value.get("sessionId"))?;

  1025	        Value::String(text) => text.clone(),
  1026	        Value::Array(items) => items
  1027	            .iter()
  1028	            .filter(|item| optional_string(item.get("type")).as_deref() == Some("text"))
  1029	            .filter_map(|item| item.get("text").and_then(Value::as_str))
  1030	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()

     1	/**
     2	 * sessionCardModel.ts — the words a session card puts on screen.
     3	 *
     4	 * PURE: no store, no DOM, no backend call, no clock of its own (`now` is a
     5	 * parameter). The card component draws what these functions return, so what a
     6	 * card SAYS can be read — and tested — without a browser.
     7	 *
     8	 * Two rules live here rather than in the markup:
     9	 *
    10	 *  - A session's status word describes its TERMINAL, not the list it sits on.
    11	 *    Which list a session is on is the user's own answer ("Mark done"), and a
    12	 *    session marked done can still have a process running. Saying "Done" for a
    13	 *    running terminal would hide a running process behind a tidy word, so a
    14	 *    done session whose terminal is still going reads "Running" and its hover
    15	 *    sentence says both things.
    16	 *
    17	 *  - A fact the store does not carry is left out, never printed empty. A
    18	 *    session started here has no reading of a conversation on disk, so its
    19	 *    detail block is simply shorter.
    20	 */
    21	import { exactLocalTime, formatLastActivity } from '../../relativeTime.ts';
    22	import type { OwnedSession } from '../../ownedSessions';
    23	
    24	/** Which colour the dot and the word wear. Not a colour itself — the component
    25	 * owns the tokens, this is only the meaning. */
    26	export type SessionStatusTone = 'running' | 'done' | 'stopped';
    27	
    28	export interface SessionStatus {
    29	  /** One word, on the card, beside the dot. */
    30	  word: string;
    31	  tone: SessionStatusTone;
    32	  /** The whole story, as a sentence, for the hover title. */
    33	  hint: string;
    34	}
    35	
    36	/**
    37	 * Running / Done / Stopped, from the terminal's state and the user's answer.
    38	 *
    39	 * "Stopped" rather than "Idle": an idle terminal is one waiting for you, and
    40	 * this one has ended. The sentence beside it says what to do about that.
    41	 */
    42	export function sessionStatus(session: Pick<OwnedSession, 'state' | 'completedAt'>): SessionStatus {
    43	  const markedDone = session.completedAt !== null;
    44	
    45	  if (session.state !== 'exited') {
    46	    return {
    47	      word: 'Running',
    48	      tone: 'running',
    49	      hint: markedDone
    50	        ? 'You marked this done, but its terminal is still running.'
    51	        : 'Its terminal is running.'
    52	    };
    53	  }
    54	
    55	  if (markedDone) {
    56	    return {
    57	      word: 'Done',
    58	      tone: 'done',
    59	      hint: 'You marked this done, and its terminal has ended.'
    60	    };
    61	  }
    62	
    63	  return {
    64	    word: 'Stopped',
    65	    tone: 'stopped',
    66	    hint: 'Its terminal has ended. Start it again to pick this session up.'
    67	  };
    68	}
    69	
    70	/**
    71	 * "12 messages" — a plain count of the turns the scanner saw. It is a floor
    72	 * rather than a total (the scanner reads a bounded window of a transcript),
    73	 * which is why it is not dressed up as a total with a "+". Nothing to say
    74	 * about a session with no conversation on disk, so it says nothing.
    75	 */
    76	export function messageCountLabel(count: number | null | undefined): string | null {
    77	  if (typeof count !== 'number' || count <= 0) return null;
    78	  return count === 1 ? '1 message' : `${count} messages`;
    79	}
    80	
    81	/** One line of the detail block: a heading and its value, with the exact
    82	 * moment kept for the hover where the value is a rounded-off time. */
    83	export interface SessionFact {
    84	  label: string;
    85	  value: string;
    86	  /** The full local date and time, when the value is a shortened stamp. */
    87	  exact?: string;
    88	}
    89	
    90	/**
    91	 * Everything the detail block says about a session, in the order a person asks
    92	 * for it: where it lives, where it came from, how big the conversation is,
    93	 * when anything last happened, when it was finished, and what typing it back
    94	 * to life looks like.
    95	 *
    96	 * The folder is always present because a session always has one. Everything
    97	 * else appears only when the store actually carries it.
    98	 */
    99	export function sessionFacts(session: OwnedSession, now: Date): SessionFact[] {
   100	  const facts: SessionFact[] = [
   101	    {
   102	      label: 'Folder',
   103	      value: session.cwd || session.projectPath || 'Not recorded'
   104	    },
   105	    {
   106	      label: 'Where it came from',
   107	      value:
   108	        session.source === 'fresh'
   109	          ? 'Started here'
   110	          : 'Found on this machine and picked up here'
   111	    }
   112	  ];
   113	
   114	  const messages = messageCountLabel(session.messageCount);
   115	  if (messages) {
   116	    facts.push({ label: 'Conversation so far', value: `${messages} (at least)` });
   117	  }
   118	
   119	  const lastActivity = formatLastActivity(session.lastActivity, now);
   120	  if (lastActivity) {
   121	    facts.push({
   122	      label: 'Last thing the scan saw',
   123	      value: lastActivity,
   124	      exact: exactLocalTime(session.lastActivity)
   125	    });
   126	  }
   127	
   128	  const finished = formatLastActivity(session.completedAt, now);
   129	  if (finished) {
   130	    facts.push({
   131	      label: 'You marked it done',
   132	      value: finished,
   133	      exact: exactLocalTime(session.completedAt)
   134	    });
   135	  }
   136	
   137	  if (session.resumeCommand) {
   138	    facts.push({ label: 'Starts back up with', value: session.resumeCommand });
   139	  }
   140	
   141	  return facts;
   142	}

   311	export function reconcileOwnedSessions(
   312	  stored: OwnedSession[],
   313	  live: Pick<TerminalSessionInfo, 'sessionId' | 'exited'>[]
   314	): { owned: OwnedSession[]; reattachable: OwnedSession[] } {

   334	      owned.push({ ...session, state: 'exited', executionOwner: 'stopped', runtimeState: 'closed' });
   335	    }
   336	  }
   337	
   338	  return { owned, reattachable };

   136	pub fn scan_sessions() -> Vec<AgentSessionRecord> {
   137	    let Some(home) = std::env::var_os("HOME").map(PathBuf::from) else {
   138	        return Vec::new();
   139	    };
   140	
   141	    let mut records = Vec::new();
   142	
   143	    // Sort the rollout files into "the user started this" and "Codex spawned
   144	    // this for itself" in one pass, keeping the ids of the second kind. Dropping
   145	    // sub-agent threads here, BEFORE the file budget, is for the same reason the
   146	    // Claude path drops its subagents first: they outnumber the user's own
   147	    // sessions nine to one, so a budget applied first would evict the sessions
   148	    // the rail exists to show.
   149	    let mut codex_files = Vec::new();
   150	    let mut codex_subagent_ids = HashSet::new();
   151	    for file in jsonl_files(&home.join(".codex/sessions")) {
   152	        match codex_rollout_thread_marker(&file) {
   153	            Some(marker) if marker.spawned_by_codex => codex_subagent_ids.extend(marker.id),
   154	            // No marker, or nothing readable: keep the file. Older Codex builds
   155	            // predate the field, and losing a session is the worse mistake.
   156	            _ => codex_files.push(file),
   157	        }
   158	    }
   159	
   160	    // Codex eventually moves a thread's rollout file into `archived_sessions`
   161	    // but leaves its index row behind, so for those threads the archive is the
   162	    // only evidence left of what kind of thread it was.
   163	    for file in jsonl_files(&home.join(".codex/archived_sessions")) {
   164	        if let Some(marker) = codex_rollout_thread_marker(&file) {
   165	            if marker.spawned_by_codex {
   166	                codex_subagent_ids.extend(marker.id);
   167	            }
   168	        }
   169	    }
   170	
   171	    let mut codex_records = Vec::new();
   172	    let codex_index = home.join(".codex/session_index.jsonl");
   173	    if let Ok(contents) = fs::read_to_string(codex_index) {
   174	        codex_records.extend(parse_codex_index_jsonl(&contents));
   175	    }
   176	    codex_records = drop_codex_subagent_sessions(codex_records, &codex_subagent_ids);
   177	
   178	    codex_files.sort_by(|a, b| modified_time(b).cmp(&modified_time(a)));

   185	        }

   192	            records.extend(parse_cmux_hook_sessions_json(&agent, &contents));
   193	        }
   194	    }

   196	    let claude_projects = home.join(".claude/projects");
   197	    let mut files = jsonl_files(&claude_projects);

   275	pub fn parse_codex_rollout_jsonl(input: &str) -> Vec<AgentSessionRecord> {
   276	    let mut records: Vec<AgentSessionRecord> = Vec::new();

   278	    let mut message_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();

   290	                let Some(payload) = value.get("payload") else {

   292	                };

   294	                    return Vec::new();
   295	                }
   296	                let Some(id) = payload.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
   297	                    continue;
   298	                };
   299	
   300	                let cwd = payload
   301	                    .get("cwd")
   302	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
   303	                    .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
   304	                    .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   305	                let last_activity = value
   306	                    .get("timestamp")
   307	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
   308	                    .or_else(|| payload.get("timestamp").and_then(Value::as_str))
   309	                    .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   310	
   311	                let record = AgentSessionRecord {
   312	                    provider: "codex".to_string(),
   313	                    id: id.to_string(),
   314	                    title: CODEX_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE.to_string(),
   315	                    description: None,
   316	                    model: model_from_value(payload),
   317	                    project_path: cwd,
   318	                    last_activity,
   319	                    resume_commands: vec![format!("codex resume {id}")],
   320	                    branch_hint: None,
   321	                    task_id: None,
   322	                    pull_request_hint: None,
   323	                    source_label: None,
   324	                    message_count: None,
   325	                    latest_turn_preview: None,
   326	                };
   327	
   328	                if let Some(existing) = records.iter_mut().find(|candidate| {
   329	                    candidate.provider == record.provider && candidate.id == record.id
   330	                }) {
   331	                    merge_codex_record(existing, record);
   332	                } else {
   333	                    records.push(record);
   334	                }
   335	            }
   336	            Some("turn_context") => {
   337	                let Some(payload) = value.get("payload") else {
   338	                    continue;
   339	                };
   340	
   341	                let cwd = payload
   342	                    .get("cwd")
   343	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
   344	                    .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
   345	                    .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   346	                let last_activity = value
   347	                    .get("timestamp")
   348	                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
   349	                    .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   350	                update_latest_codex_record(

   352	                    cwd,
   353	                    None,
   354	                    model_from_value(payload),
   355	                    last_activity,
   356	                );
   357	            }
   358	            Some("response_item") => {
   359	                if let (Some(record), Some(prompt)) =
   360	                    (records.last(), codex_user_prompt_text(&value))
   361	                {
   362	                    first_prompts.entry(record.id.clone()).or_insert(prompt);
   363	                }
   364	
   365	                if let Some(id) = records.last().map(|record| record.id.clone()) {
   366	                    if let Some((speaker, turn)) = codex_conversation_turn(&value) {
   367	                        // Codex writes a separate record for every paragraph it
   368	                        // narrates between tool calls, so a run of them is ONE
   369	                        // thing the agent said back, not twenty. Without this a
   370	                        // Codex row read "691 messages" where the Claude row
   371	                        // beside it, for a longer conversation, read "33".

   409	/// Who said one message of a Codex conversation.
   410	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
   411	enum CodexSpeaker {
   412	    User,
   413	    Agent,
   414	}
   415	
   416	/// One message of a Codex conversation: who said it, and how a row would show
   417	/// it. The user side uses the same filter the title does, so the opening turns
   418	/// Codex writes for itself — the repository instructions, the environment block
   419	/// — are neither counted nor shown; the agent side needs actual words.
   420	fn codex_conversation_turn(value: &Value) -> Option<(CodexSpeaker, String)> {
   421	    let payload = value.get("payload")?;
   422	    if payload.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("message") {
   423	        return None;
   424	    }
   425	
   426	    match payload.get("role").and_then(Value::as_str)? {
   427	        "user" => Some((
   428	            CodexSpeaker::User,
   429	            agent_session_turn_preview(
   430	                AGENT_SESSION_USER_TURN_PREFIX,
   431	                &codex_typed_user_text(value)?,
   432	            ),
   433	        )),
   434	        "assistant" => {
   435	            let text = payload.get("content").and_then(value_to_text)?;
   436	            let text = text.trim();
   437	            (!text.is_empty()).then(|| {
   438	                (
   439	                    CodexSpeaker::Agent,
   440	                    agent_session_turn_preview(AGENT_SESSION_AGENT_TURN_PREFIX, text),
   441	                )
   442	            })
   443	        }
   444	        _ => None,
   445	    }
   446	}
   447	
   448	/// Codex spawns its own helper threads and writes each one as a rollout file
   449	/// next to the user's, so nine of every ten files under `~/.codex/sessions` are
   450	/// threads nobody opened. The opening `session_meta` record says which it is:
   451	/// a helper carries `thread_source: "subagent"`, and/or a `source` object whose
   452	/// only key is `subagent` (a session the user started has `source` as a plain
   453	/// string — `cli`, `vscode`, `exec`).
   454	///
   455	/// Verified 2026-07-28 across 687 rollout files on this machine: 619 helper
   456	/// threads, 68 sessions the user started, and the two markers disagreed on a
   457	/// single file — so both are checked and either one is enough.
   458	///
   459	/// A file with neither marker is kept. Older Codex versions predate the field
   460	/// (15 files here), and losing one of the user's sessions is worse than listing
   461	/// a helper thread.
   462	fn is_codex_subagent_meta(payload: &Value) -> bool {
   463	    if payload.get("thread_source").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("subagent") {
   464	        return true;
   465	    }
   466	
   467	    payload
   468	        .get("source")
   469	        .and_then(Value::as_object)
   470	        .is_some_and(|source| source.contains_key("subagent"))
   471	}
   472	
   473	/// What a rollout file's opening metadata record says about its thread. The id
   474	/// can be missing while the verdict is still known, so the two are separate.
   475	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
   476	pub struct CodexThreadMarker {
   477	    pub id: Option<String>,
   478	    pub spawned_by_codex: bool,
   479	}
   480	
   481	/// Read from a bounded head, so the scan can sort the files before it spends
   482	/// its read budget on them.
   483	fn codex_rollout_thread_marker(path: &Path) -> Option<CodexThreadMarker> {
   484	    let head = read_head_utf8(path, CODEX_SESSION_META_PROBE_BYTES).ok()?;
   485	    codex_rollout_head_thread_marker(&head)
   486	}
   487	
   488	/// `None` when the head holds no readable metadata record — a truncated line, a
   489	/// file that opens with something else, an empty file. The caller keeps those.
   490	pub fn codex_rollout_head_thread_marker(head: &str) -> Option<CodexThreadMarker> {
   491	    let line = head.lines().next()?;
   492	    let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line).ok()?;
   493	    if value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("session_meta") {
   494	        return None;
   495	    }
   496	
   497	    let payload = value.get("payload")?;
   498	    Some(CodexThreadMarker {
   499	        id: payload
   500	            .get("id")
   501	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
   502	            .map(ToOwned::to_owned),
   503	        spawned_by_codex: is_codex_subagent_meta(payload),
   504	    })
   505	}
   506	
   507	pub fn codex_rollout_head_is_subagent_thread(head: &str) -> bool {
   508	    codex_rollout_head_thread_marker(head).is_some_and(|marker| marker.spawned_by_codex)
   509	}

   511	/// Index rows naming threads Codex spawned for itself.
   512	///
   513	/// `~/.codex/session_index.jsonl` is a flat list of id, name and timestamp with
   514	/// nothing in it saying what kind of thread a row describes, so the rollout
   515	/// files are the only evidence — and the index is read whole, with none of the
   516	/// filtering the rollout files get. On this machine 119 of its 330 rows are
   517	/// sub-agent threads, 117 of them already archived, and every one of those was
   518	/// reaching the rail under a plausible name ("Audit inventory gaps", "Review
   519	/// mobile steppers") that gave the user no way to tell it apart from their own
   520	/// work.
   521	///
   522	/// A row whose thread has no rollout file left anywhere is kept: 150 of them
   523	/// here, all genuinely the user's, and absence of evidence is not evidence.
   524	pub fn drop_codex_subagent_sessions(
   525	    records: Vec<AgentSessionRecord>,
   526	    subagent_ids: &HashSet<String>,
   527	) -> Vec<AgentSessionRecord> {
   528	    records
   529	        .into_iter()
   530	        .filter(|record| !subagent_ids.contains(&record.id))
   531	        .collect()
   532	}
   533	
   534	/// The first thing the user actually typed. Codex opens every session with
   535	/// machine-written turns sent as the user — the repository's `AGENTS.md`, the
   536	/// environment block, the plugin list, the file list — and each has a shape we
   537	/// can recognise, so the title comes from the first turn that is none of them.
   538	fn codex_user_prompt_text(value: &Value) -> Option<String> {
   539	    codex_typed_user_text(value).map(|text| compact_text(&text, 140))
   540	}
   541	
   542	/// The same turn, at full length, for callers that do their own cutting.
   543	fn codex_typed_user_text(value: &Value) -> Option<String> {
   544	    let payload = value.get("payload")?;
   545	    if payload.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("message") {
   546	        return None;
   547	    }
   548	    if payload.get("role").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("user") {
   549	        return None;
   550	    }
   551	
   552	    let text = payload.get("content").and_then(value_to_text)?;
   553	    let text = text.trim();
   554	    if text.is_empty() || CODEX_INJECTED_PROMPT_PREFIXES.iter().any(|prefix| text.starts_with(prefix)) {
   555	        return None;
   556	    }
   557	
   558	    Some(text.to_string())
   559	}
   560	
   561	/// Openings that mean Codex wrote this turn, not the user. `<` covers every
   562	/// tagged block it injects (`<environment_context>`, `<recommended_plugins>`,
   563	/// `<user_shell_command>`); the two headings are the repository instructions
   564	/// and the attached-file list.
   565	const CODEX_INJECTED_PROMPT_PREFIXES: &[&str] = &[
   566	    "<",
   567	    "# AGENTS.md instructions",
   568	    "# Files mentioned by the user",
   569	];
   570	
   571	/// A Codex rollout file carries no title of its own, so a rail built from these
   572	/// files alone reads as hundreds of rows all saying "Codex session". The first
   573	/// typed prompt is the only description of the session in the file, so it
   574	/// becomes the title; the generic label survives only when the scanned window
   575	/// held no typed prompt at all.
   576	fn codex_display_title(derived: &str, first_prompt: Option<&str>) -> String {
   577	    if derived != CODEX_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE {
   578	        return derived.to_string();
   579	    }
   580	
   581	    match first_prompt {
   582	        Some(prompt) => compact_text(prompt, 60),
   583	        None => CODEX_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE.to_string(),
   584	    }
   585	}
   586	
   587	fn is_generic_codex_title(title: &str) -> bool {
   588	    title == CODEX_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE || title == CODEX_UNTITLED_INDEX_TITLE
   589	}
   590	
   591	/// One Codex session can be described twice: the index file may name it, and
   592	/// the rollout file offers the opening prompt. Whichever record looks newer is
   593	/// beside the point — a placeholder must never displace a real title, and the
   594	/// index name describes the whole session where the prompt only opens it, so
   595	/// the title already in hand wins when both are real.
   596	fn better_codex_title(existing: String, candidate: String) -> String {
   597	    if !is_generic_codex_title(&existing) {
   598	        return existing;
   599	    }
   600	    if !is_generic_codex_title(&candidate) {
   601	        return candidate;
   602	    }
   603	
   604	    existing
   605	}

   607	fn update_latest_codex_record(
   608	    records: &mut [AgentSessionRecord],
   609	    cwd: Option<String>,
   610	    description: Option<String>,
   611	    model: Option<String>,
   612	    last_activity: Option<String>,
   613	) {
   614	    let Some(record) = records.last_mut() else {
   615	        return;
   616	    };
   617	
   618	    let id = record.id.clone();
   619	    let update = AgentSessionRecord {
   620	        provider: "codex".to_string(),

   624	        model,
   625	        project_path: cwd,
   626	        last_activity,
   627	        resume_commands: vec![format!("codex resume {id}")],
   628	        branch_hint: None,
   629	        task_id: None,
   630	        pull_request_hint: None,
   631	        source_label: None,
   632	        message_count: None,

   635	    merge_codex_record(record, update);

   638	fn codex_response_item_workdir(value: &Value) -> Option<String> {

   641	        return None;

   643	
   644	    let arguments = payload.get("arguments").and_then(Value::as_str)?;

   754	pub fn parse_claude_jsonl(input: &str, project_path: &str) -> Vec<AgentSessionRecord> {
   755	    let mut records: Vec<AgentSessionRecord> = Vec::new();
   756	    let mut ai_titles: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
   757	    let mut first_prompts: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
   758	    let mut message_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();
   759	    let mut latest_turns: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
   760	
   761	    for value in input
   762	        .lines()
   763	        .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(line).ok())
   764	    {
   765	        // One such entry condemns the whole transcript: these files are what
   766	        // they are end to end, so anything already collected from one is an
   767	        // agent's turn, not a session the user can resume. Both checks answer
   768	        // the same question — "is this a top-level session?" — from different
   769	        // evidence: a subagent's sidechain flag, or a helper's entrypoint.
   770	        if is_claude_sidechain_entry(&value) || is_claude_agent_launched_entry(&value) {
   771	            return Vec::new();
   772	        }
   773	
   774	        if let Some((session, title)) = claude_ai_title(&value) {
   775	            ai_titles.insert(session, title); // a later line carries the newer title
   776	        }
   777	        if let Some((session, prompt)) = claude_user_prompt_text(&value) {
   778	            first_prompts.entry(session).or_insert(prompt);
   779	        }
   780	        if let Some((session, turn)) = claude_conversation_turn(&value) {
   781	            *message_counts.entry(session.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
   782	            latest_turns.insert(session, turn); // a later line is the newer turn
   783	        }
   784	
   785	        let Some(id) = value
   786	            .get("sessionId")
   787	            .or_else(|| value.get("session_id"))
   788	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
   789	        else {
   790	            continue;
   791	        };
   792	
   793	        let timestamp = value
   794	            .get("timestamp")
   795	            .or_else(|| value.get("created_at"))
   796	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
   797	            .map(ToOwned::to_owned);
   798	
   799	        let cwd = value
   800	            .get("cwd")
   801	            .and_then(Value::as_str)
   802	            .unwrap_or(project_path)
   803	            .to_string();
   804	
   805	        let title = title_from_claude_message(&value)
   806	            .unwrap_or_else(|| CLAUDE_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE.to_string());
   807	        let record = AgentSessionRecord {
   808	            provider: "claude".to_string(),
   809	            id: id.to_string(),
   810	            title,
   811	            description: claude_session_description(&value),
   812	            model: value
   813	                .get("message")
   814	                .and_then(model_from_value)
   815	                .or_else(|| model_from_value(&value)),
   816	            project_path: (!cwd.is_empty()).then_some(cwd.clone()),
   817	            last_activity: timestamp,
   818	            resume_commands: vec![
   819	                format!("claude --resume {id}"),
   820	                format!("cd {} && claude --resume {id}", shell_quote(&cwd)),
   821	            ],
   822	            branch_hint: None,
   823	            task_id: None,
   824	            pull_request_hint: None,
   825	            source_label: None,
   826	            message_count: None,
   827	            latest_turn_preview: None,
   828	        };
   829	
   830	        if let Some(existing) = records
   831	            .iter_mut()
   832	            .find(|candidate| candidate.provider == record.provider && candidate.id == record.id)
   833	        {
   834	            merge_agent_session_record(existing, record);
   835	        } else {
   836	            records.push(record);
   837	        }
   838	    }
   839	
   840	    for record in records.iter_mut() {
   841	        record.title = claude_display_title(
   842	            &record.title,
   843	            ai_titles.get(&record.id).map(String::as_str),
   844	            first_prompts.get(&record.id).map(String::as_str),
   845	            record.project_path.as_deref(),
   846	        );
   847	        record.message_count = message_counts.get(&record.id).copied();
   848	        record.latest_turn_preview = latest_turns.get(&record.id).cloned();
   849	    }
   850	
   851	    records
   852	}
   998	/// Openings that mean Claude Code wrote this "user" message, not the user. `<`
   999	/// covers every tagged block it injects (`<command-name>`,
  1000	/// `<local-command-caveat>`); the resume caveat and the interruption notice are
  1001	/// the two it writes as plain sentences.
  1002	///
  1003	/// The interruption matters more than it looks. Pressing Escape in the middle
  1004	/// of an answer is how a session usually ends, so it is disproportionately
  1005	/// likely to be the LAST thing in a transcript — and the row shows the last
  1006	/// thing said. In 617 real user turns sampled on this machine, 50 of them were
  1007	/// exactly "[Request interrupted by user]".
  1008	const CLAUDE_INJECTED_PROMPT_PREFIXES: &[&str] =
  1009	    &["<", "Caveat:", "[Request interrupted"];
  1010	
  1011	/// The first genuine user prompt in the scanned window. Tool results are
  1012	/// `type: "user"` too, so plain `content` text is required and `tool_result`
  1013	/// items are dropped; anything Claude Code wrote for itself is skipped because
  1014	/// none of it says what the session is about.
  1015	fn claude_user_prompt_text(value: &Value) -> Option<(String, String)> {
  1016	    if optional_string(value.get("type"))? != "user" {
  1017	        return None;
  1018	    }
  1019	    if value.get("isMeta").and_then(Value::as_bool) == Some(true) {
  1020	        return None;
  1021	    }
  1022	
  1023	    let id = optional_string(value.get("sessionId"))?;
  1024	    let text = match value.get("message")?.get("content")? {
  1025	        Value::String(text) => text.clone(),
  1026	        Value::Array(items) => items
  1027	            .iter()
  1028	            .filter(|item| optional_string(item.get("type")).as_deref() == Some("text"))
  1029	            .filter_map(|item| item.get("text").and_then(Value::as_str))
  1030	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
  1031	            .join(" "),
  1032	        _ => return None,
  1033	    };
  1034	
  1035	    let text = text.trim();
  1036	    if text.is_empty()
  1037	        || CLAUDE_INJECTED_PROMPT_PREFIXES
  1038	            .iter()
  1039	            .any(|prefix| text.starts_with(prefix))
  1040	    {
  1041	        return None;
  1042	    }
  1043	
  1044	    Some((id, text.to_string()))
  1045	}
  1046	
  1047	/// Title preference for a Claude row: the session's own AI title, then whatever
  1048	/// a message yielded, then `<project folder> — <first user prompt>`. The generic
  1049	/// label survives only when nothing else exists — a rail full of "Claude
  1050	/// session" rows tells the user nothing about which session to resume.
  1051	fn claude_display_title(
  1052	    derived: &str,
  1053	    ai_title: Option<&str>,
  1054	    first_prompt: Option<&str>,
  1055	    project_path: Option<&str>,
  1056	) -> String {
  1057	    if let Some(title) = ai_title {
  1058	        return compact_text(title, 80);
  1059	    }
  1060	    if derived != CLAUDE_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE {
  1061	        return derived.to_string();
  1062	    }
  1063	
  1064	    match (first_prompt, project_path.and_then(path_display_name)) {
  1065	        (Some(prompt), Some(folder)) => compact_text(&format!("{folder} — {prompt}"), 60),
  1066	        (Some(prompt), None) => compact_text(prompt, 60),
  1067	        (None, _) => CLAUDE_GENERIC_SESSION_TITLE.to_string(),
  1068	    }
  1069	}
  1070	
  1071	fn cmux_resume_commands(agent: &str, id: &str, cwd: Option<&str>) -> Vec<String> {
  1072	    let command = match agent {
  1073	        "codex" => format!("codex resume {id}"),
  1074	        "claude" => format!("claude --resume {id}"),
  1075	        "gemini" => format!("gemini --resume {id}"),
  1076	        "opencode" => format!("opencode --session {id}"),
  1077	        "omp" | "pi" => format!("{agent} --session {id}"),
  1078	        "amp" => format!("amp threads continue {id}"),
  1079	        "antigravity" | "agy" => format!("agy --conversation {id}"),
  1080	        "rovo" | "acli" => format!("acli rovodev run --restore {id}"),
  1081	        "cursor" | "cursor-agent" => format!("cursor-agent --resume {id}"),
  1082	        other => format!("{other} --resume {id}"),
  1083	    };
  1084	
  1085	    match cwd.filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty()) {
  1086	        Some(cwd) => vec![
  1087	            command.clone(),
  1088	            format!("cd {} && {command}", shell_quote(cwd)),
  1089	        ],
  1090	        None => vec![command],
  1091	    }
  1092	}
  1093	
  1094	fn merge_codex_record(existing: &mut AgentSessionRecord, candidate: AgentSessionRecord) {
  1095	    let previous_title = existing.title.clone();
  1096	    let candidate_title = candidate.title.clone();
  1097	    merge_agent_session_record(existing, candidate);
  1098	    existing.title = better_codex_title(previous_title, candidate_title);
  1099	}
  1100	
  1101	fn merge_agent_session_record(existing: &mut AgentSessionRecord, candidate: AgentSessionRecord) {
  1102	    if existing.description.is_none() {
  1103	        existing.description = candidate.description.clone();
  1104	    }
  1105	
  1106	    if existing.model.is_none() {
  1107	        existing.model = candidate.model.clone();
  1108	    }
  1109	
  1110	    if existing.project_path.is_none() {
  1111	        existing.project_path = candidate.project_path.clone();
  1112	    }
  1113	
  1114	    // The fuller read wins, whichever record it came from. One session can be
  1115	    // described by more than one file, and each count is a floor — the bigger
  1116	    // floor is the one closer to the truth. (`None` sorts below every `Some`,
  1117	    // so a record that counted nothing never overwrites one that did.)
  1118	    existing.message_count = existing.message_count.max(candidate.message_count);
  1119	
  1120	    if existing.latest_turn_preview.is_none() {
  1121	        existing.latest_turn_preview = candidate.latest_turn_preview.clone();
  1122	    }
  1123	
  1124	    let candidate_is_newer = candidate
  1125	        .last_activity
  1126	        .as_ref()
  1127	        .is_some_and(|candidate_activity| {
  1128	            existing
  1129	                .last_activity
  1130	                .as_ref()
  1131	                .map_or(true, |existing_activity| {
  1132	                    candidate_activity > existing_activity
  1133	                })
  1134	        });
  1135	
    80	  gitRoot: string | null;
    81	  message: string;
    82	};
    83	
    84	export type LocalAgentSessionRecord = {
    85	  provider: string;
    86	  id: string;
    87	  title: string;
    88	  description: string | null;
    89	  model: string | null;
    90	  projectPath: string | null;
    91	  lastActivity: string | null;
    92	  resumeCommands: string[];
    93	  /**
    94	   * What the scan worked out about the session from its own title, folder and
    95	   * resume command — the branch it is on, the task it belongs to, the pull
    96	   * request it opened, and a short "who and where" label. Filled in once, at the
    97	   * end of the scan, so everything that builds a record along the way leaves
    98	   * them empty; a row draws a chip only for the ones that are there.
    99	   */
   100	  branchHint?: string | null;
   101	  taskId?: string | null;
   102	  pullRequestHint?: string | null;
   103	  sourceLabel?: string | null;
   104	  /**
   105	   * How many turns of the conversation the scan saw, and the last one of them,
   106	   * so a row can say "12 messages" and show what was last said.
   107	   *
   108	   * Both are read out of the transcript text the scan already had in hand for
   109	   * the title — no extra file is opened and no read window is widened. That
   110	   * means the count is a floor rather than a total: the scan reads a bounded
   111	   * window of each file, so a long session reports the turns inside that window
   112	   * and no more. A row that says "12 messages" is saying "at least 12", which
   113	   * is the honest thing a bounded read can say.
   114	   *
   115	   * A turn is something the user typed or something the agent said back in
   116	   * words. Tool calls and their results are how the work gets done, not what was

   155	    pullRequestHint: firstAgentSessionHint(record, pullRequestHintFromText),
   156	    linkHint: firstAgentSessionHint(record, linkHintFromText),

   166	 * session is described by several files, and only the merged record has the
   167	 * title, folder and resume command the hints are read from.

   174	    record.pullRequestHint = metadata.pullRequestHint;
   175	    record.sourceLabel = metadata.sourceLabel;
   176	  }

   224	export async function scanLocalAgentSessions(homeRoot = homedir()): Promise<LocalAgentSessionRecord[]> {
   225	  const homePath = homeRoot.trim();
   226	  if (!homePath) return [];
   227	
   228	  const records: LocalAgentSessionRecord[] = [];
   229	
   230	  // Sort the rollout files into "the user started this" and "Codex spawned this
   231	  // for itself" in one pass, keeping the ids of the second kind. Dropping
   232	  // sub-agent threads here, BEFORE the file budget, is for the same reason the
   233	  // Claude path drops its subagents first: they outnumber the user's own
   234	  // sessions nine to one, so a budget applied first would evict the sessions the
   235	  // rail exists to show.
   236	  const codexRollouts: string[] = [];
   237	  const codexSubagentIds = new Set<string>();
   238	  for (const filePath of await jsonlFiles(path.join(homePath, '.codex', 'sessions'))) {
   239	    const marker = await codexRolloutFileThreadMarker(filePath);
   240	    // No marker, or nothing readable: keep the file. Older Codex builds predate
   241	    // the field, and losing a session is the worse mistake.
   242	    if (!marker?.spawnedByCodex) codexRollouts.push(filePath);
   243	    else if (marker.id) codexSubagentIds.add(marker.id);
   244	  }
   245	
   246	  // Codex eventually moves a thread's rollout file into `archived_sessions` but
   247	  // leaves its index row behind, so for those threads the archive is the only
   248	  // evidence left of what kind of thread it was.
   249	  for (const filePath of await jsonlFiles(path.join(homePath, '.codex', 'archived_sessions'))) {
   250	    const marker = await codexRolloutFileThreadMarker(filePath);
   251	    if (marker?.spawnedByCodex && marker.id) codexSubagentIds.add(marker.id);
   252	  }
   253	
   254	  const codexIndex = path.join(homePath, '.codex', 'session_index.jsonl');
   255	  const codexIndexContents = await readFile(codexIndex, 'utf8').catch(() => '');
   256	  const codexRecords = dropCodexSubagentSessions(
   257	    codexIndexContents ? parseCodexIndexJsonl(codexIndexContents) : [],
   258	    codexSubagentIds
   259	  );
   260	
   261	  const codexFiles = await sortFilesByModifiedDesc(codexRollouts);
   262	  const codexMetadata: LocalAgentSessionRecord[] = [];
   263	  for (const filePath of codexFiles.slice(0, codexSessionFileLimit)) {
   264	    const contents = await readHeadAndTailUtf8(
   265	      filePath,
   266	      codexSessionHeadBytes,
   267	      codexSessionTailBytes
   268	    ).catch(() => '');
   269	    if (contents) codexMetadata.push(...parseCodexRolloutJsonl(contents));
   270	  }
   271	  records.push(...mergeCodexSessionMetadata(codexRecords, codexMetadata));
   272	
   273	  const cmuxRoot = path.join(homePath, '.cmuxterm');
   274	  for (const { agent, filePath } of await cmuxHookSessionFiles(cmuxRoot)) {
   275	    const contents = await readFile(filePath, 'utf8').catch(() => '');
   276	    if (contents) records.push(...parseCmuxHookSessionsJson(agent, contents));
   277	  }
   278	
   279	  // Drop subagent transcripts and helper runs BEFORE the file budget is
   280	  // applied: they outnumber real sessions on a busy machine and would otherwise
   281	  // evict them.
   282	  const claudeTranscripts: string[] = [];
   283	  for (const filePath of await jsonlFiles(path.join(homePath, '.claude', 'projects'))) {
   284	    if (isClaudeSubagentTranscriptPath(filePath)) continue;
   285	    if (await claudeTranscriptFileIsAgentLaunched(filePath)) continue;
   286	    claudeTranscripts.push(filePath);
   287	  }
   288	  const claudeFiles = await sortFilesByModifiedDesc(claudeTranscripts);
   289	  for (const filePath of claudeFiles.slice(0, claudeSessionFileLimit)) {
   290	    const projectPath = decodeClaudeProjectDir(path.basename(path.dirname(filePath))) ?? '';
   291	    const contents = await readTailUtf8(filePath, claudeSessionTailBytes).catch(() => '');
   292	    if (contents) records.push(...parseClaudeJsonl(contents, projectPath));
   293	  }
   294	
   295	  return withDerivedAgentSessionMetadata(
   296	    mergeAgentSessionRecords(records)
   297	      .sort((left, right) => compareNullableStringsDescending(left.lastActivity, right.lastActivity))
   298	      .slice(0, agentSessionResultLimit)
   299	  );
   300	}

   302	async function findGitRoot(root: string): Promise<string | null> {
   303	  let current = normalizeRootPath(root);
   304	
   305	  while (true) {
   306	    if (await stat(path.join(current, '.git')).catch(() => null)) {
   307	      return current;
   308	    }
   309	
   310	    const parent = path.dirname(current);
   311	    if (parent === current) return null;
   312	    current = parent;
   313	  }
   314	}

   316	export function parseCodexIndexJsonl(input: string): LocalAgentSessionRecord[] {
   317	  return parseJsonLines(input).flatMap((value) => {
   318	    const id = optionalString(value.id);
   319	    if (!id) return [];
   320	
   321	    return [
   322	      {
   323	        provider: 'codex',
   324	        id,
   325	        title: optionalString(value.thread_name) ?? codexUntitledIndexTitle,
   326	        description: null,
   327	        model: modelFromValue(value),
   328	        projectPath: null,

   330	        resumeCommands: [`codex resume ${id}`]
   331	      }
   332	    ];
   333	  });

   336	export function parseCodexRolloutJsonl(input: string): LocalAgentSessionRecord[] {
   337	  const records: LocalAgentSessionRecord[] = [];
   338	  const firstPrompts = new Map<string, string>();
   339	  const messageCounts = new Map<string, number>();
   340	  const latestTurns = new Map<string, string>();
   341	  // Who spoke last in each session, so a run of agent narration can be counted
   342	  // as the one thing the agent said rather than as twenty.
   343	  const lastSpeakers = new Map<string, CodexSpeaker>();
   344	
   345	  for (const value of parseJsonLines(input)) {
   346	    const type = optionalString(value.type);
   347	    if (type === 'session_meta') {
   348	      const payload = objectValue(value.payload);
   349	      if (payload && isCodexSubagentMeta(payload)) return [];
   350	      const id = optionalString(payload?.id);
   351	      if (!payload || !id) continue;
   352	
   353	      const record: LocalAgentSessionRecord = {
   354	        provider: 'codex',
   355	        id,
   356	        title: codexGenericSessionTitle,
   357	        description: null,
   358	        model: modelFromValue(payload),
   359	        projectPath: optionalString(payload.cwd),
   360	        lastActivity: optionalString(value.timestamp) ?? optionalString(payload.timestamp),
   361	        resumeCommands: [`codex resume ${id}`]
   362	      };
   363	      upsertCodexSessionRecord(records, record);
   364	      continue;
   365	    }
   366	
   367	    if (type === 'turn_context') {
   368	      const payload = objectValue(value.payload);
   369	      if (!payload) continue;
   370	      updateLatestCodexRecord(
   371	        records,
   372	        optionalString(payload.cwd),
   373	        null,
   374	        modelFromValue(payload),
   375	        optionalString(value.timestamp)
   376	      );
   377	      continue;
   378	    }
   379	
   380	    if (type === 'response_item') {
   381	      const latest = records[records.length - 1];
   382	      const prompt = codexUserPromptText(value);
   383	      if (latest && prompt && !firstPrompts.has(latest.id)) firstPrompts.set(latest.id, prompt);
   384	
   385	      const turn = latest ? codexConversationTurn(value) : null;
   386	      if (latest && turn) {
   387	        const [speaker, text] = turn;
   388	        // Codex writes a separate record for every paragraph it narrates
   389	        // between tool calls, so a run of them is ONE thing the agent said
   390	        // back, not twenty. Without this a Codex row read "691 messages" where
   391	        // the Claude row beside it, for a longer conversation, read "33".
   392	        const repeatNarration = speaker === 'agent' && lastSpeakers.get(latest.id) === 'agent';
   393	        if (!repeatNarration) {
   394	          messageCounts.set(latest.id, (messageCounts.get(latest.id) ?? 0) + 1);
   395	        }
   396	        lastSpeakers.set(latest.id, speaker);
   397	        latestTurns.set(latest.id, text); // a later line is the newer turn
   398	      }
   399	
   400	      const cwd = codexResponseItemWorkdir(value);
   401	      const description = codexResponseItemDescription(value);
   402	      if (!cwd && !description) continue;
   403	      updateLatestCodexRecord(records, cwd, description, null, optionalString(value.timestamp));
   404	    }
   405	  }
   406	
   407	  for (const record of records) {
   408	    record.title = codexDisplayTitle(record.title, firstPrompts.get(record.id) ?? null);
   409	    record.messageCount = messageCounts.get(record.id) ?? null;
   410	    record.latestTurnPreview = latestTurns.get(record.id) ?? null;
   411	  }
   412	
   413	  return records;
   414	}

   693	export function parseClaudeJsonl(input: string, projectPath: string): LocalAgentSessionRecord[] {
   694	  const records: LocalAgentSessionRecord[] = [];
   695	  const aiTitles = new Map<string, string>();
   696	  const firstPrompts = new Map<string, string>();
   697	  const messageCounts = new Map<string, number>();
   698	  const latestTurns = new Map<string, string>();
   699	
   700	  for (const value of parseJsonLines(input)) {
   701	    // One such entry condemns the whole transcript: these files are what they
   702	    // are end to end, so anything already collected from one is an agent's
   703	    // turn, not a session the user can resume. Both checks answer the same
   704	    // question — "is this a top-level session?" — from different evidence: a
   705	    // subagent's sidechain flag, or a helper's entrypoint.
   706	    if (isClaudeSidechainEntry(value) || isClaudeAgentLaunchedEntry(value)) return [];
   707	
   708	    const aiTitle = claudeAiTitle(value);
   709	    if (aiTitle) aiTitles.set(aiTitle[0], aiTitle[1]); // a later line is the newer title
   710	    const prompt = claudeUserPromptText(value);
   711	    if (prompt && !firstPrompts.has(prompt[0])) firstPrompts.set(prompt[0], prompt[1]);
   712	    const turn = claudeConversationTurn(value);
   713	    if (turn) {
   714	      messageCounts.set(turn[0], (messageCounts.get(turn[0]) ?? 0) + 1);
   715	      latestTurns.set(turn[0], turn[1]); // a later line is the newer turn
   716	    }
   717	
   718	    const id = optionalString(value.sessionId) ?? optionalString(value.session_id);
   719	    if (!id) continue;
   720	
   721	    const cwd = optionalString(value.cwd) ?? projectPath;
   722	    upsertAgentSessionRecord(records, {
   723	      provider: 'claude',
   724	      id,
   725	      title: titleFromClaudeMessage(value) ?? claudeGenericSessionTitle,
   726	      description: claudeSessionDescription(value),
   727	      model: modelFromValue(objectValue(value.message)) ?? modelFromValue(value),
   728	      projectPath: cwd || null,
   729	      lastActivity: optionalString(value.timestamp) ?? optionalString(value.created_at),
   730	      resumeCommands: [
   731	        `claude --resume ${id}`,
   732	        cwd ? `cd ${shellQuote(cwd)} && claude --resume ${id}` : `claude --resume ${id}`
   733	      ]
   734	    });
   735	  }
   736	
   737	  for (const record of records) {
   738	    record.title = claudeDisplayTitle(
   739	      record.title,
   740	      aiTitles.get(record.id) ?? null,
   741	      firstPrompts.get(record.id) ?? null,
   742	      record.projectPath
   743	    );
   744	    record.messageCount = messageCounts.get(record.id) ?? null;
   745	    record.latestTurnPreview = latestTurns.get(record.id) ?? null;
   746	  }
   747	
   748	  return records;

   971	  const merged: LocalAgentSessionRecord[] = [];

   973	    upsertAgentSessionRecord(merged, record);

   978	function upsertAgentSessionRecord(records: LocalAgentSessionRecord[], record: LocalAgentSessionRecord) {
   979	  const existing = records.find(
   980	    (candidate) => candidate.provider === record.provider && candidate.id === record.id
   981	  );
   982	  if (existing) {
   983	    mergeAgentSessionRecord(existing, record);
   984	  } else {
   985	    records.push(record);
   986	  }
   987	}

   989	function mergeAgentSessionRecord(existing: LocalAgentSessionRecord, candidate: LocalAgentSessionRecord) {
   990	  if (!existing.description) existing.description = candidate.description;
   991	  if (!existing.model) existing.model = candidate.model;
   992	  if (!existing.projectPath) existing.projectPath = candidate.projectPath;
   993	
   994	  // The fuller read wins, whichever record it came from. One session can be
   995	  // described by more than one file, and each count is a floor — the bigger
   996	  // floor is the one closer to the truth. A record that counted nothing never
   997	  // overwrites one that did.
   998	  if (typeof candidate.messageCount === 'number') {
   999	    existing.messageCount = Math.max(existing.messageCount ?? 0, candidate.messageCount);
  1000	  }
  1001	  if (!existing.latestTurnPreview) existing.latestTurnPreview = candidate.latestTurnPreview;
  1002	
  1003	  const candidateIsNewer =
  1004	    candidate.lastActivity !== null
  1005	    && (existing.lastActivity === null || candidate.lastActivity > existing.lastActivity);
  1006	  if (candidateIsNewer) {
  1007	    existing.title = candidate.title;
  1008	    existing.description = candidate.description ?? existing.description;
  1009	    existing.model = candidate.model ?? existing.model;
  1010	    existing.projectPath = candidate.projectPath ?? existing.projectPath;

  1049	/// label survives only when nothing else exists — a rail full of "Claude

  1071	fn cmux_resume_commands(agent: &str, id: &str, cwd: Option<&str>) -> Vec<String> {

  1074	        "claude" => format!("claude --resume {id}"),
  1075	        "gemini" => format!("gemini --resume {id}"),
  1076	        "opencode" => format!("opencode --session {id}"),
  1077	        "omp" | "pi" => format!("{agent} --session {id}"),
  1078	        "amp" => format!("amp threads continue {id}"),
  1079	        "antigravity" | "agy" => format!("agy --conversation {id}"),
  1080	        "rovo" | "acli" => format!("acli rovodev run --restore {id}"),
  1081	        "cursor" | "cursor-agent" => format!("cursor-agent --resume {id}"),
  1082	        other => format!("{other} --resume {id}"),
  1083	    };
  1084	
  1085	    match cwd.filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty()) {
  1086	        Some(cwd) => vec![
  1087	            command.clone(),
  1088	            format!("cd {} && {command}", shell_quote(cwd)),
  1089	        ],
  1090	        None => vec![command],
  1091	    }
  1092	}

   770	  /** EXPLICIT IO: scan for resumable agent sessions (Tauri first, bridge second).
   771	   * ONE counted call per rescan, named for the transport that actually ran. */
   772	  async function scanRail(): Promise<void> {
   773	    if (rail.scanning) return;
   774	    rail.scanning = true;
   775	    rail.error = null;
   776	    let nativeError: string | null = null;
   777	    try {
   778	      let sessions: AgentSession[] | null = null;
   779	      try {
   780	        sessions = await listAgentSessionsFromTauri();
   781	      } catch (error) {
   782	        nativeError = describeError(error);
   783	      }
   784	      // A `null` native result with no error = not under Tauri: nothing invoked.
   785	      countInvoke((sessions ?? nativeError) ? 'list_agent_sessions' : 'bridge:agent-sessions');
   786	      sessions ??= await listAgentSessionsFromLocalBridge();
   787	      if (disposed) return;
   788	      setAvailable(sessions ?? []);
   789	      // Surface the native failure only if the bridge produced nothing either.
   790	      if (sessions === null && nativeError) rail.error = `session scan failed: ${nativeError}`;
   791	    } catch (error) {
   792	      if (!disposed) rail.error = `session scan failed: ${nativeError ?? describeError(error)}`;
   793	    } finally {
   794	      rail.scanning = false;
   795	    }
   796	  }

   320	export function paginateSessionLibrary(
   321	  records: readonly SessionLibraryRecord[],

   323	  pageSize = 50
   324	): SessionLibraryPage {
   325	  const safePageSize = Number.isInteger(pageSize) && pageSize > 0 ? pageSize : 50;
   326	  const totalItems = records.length;
   327	  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / safePageSize));

   332	    page: safePage,
   333	    pageSize: safePageSize,
   334	    totalItems,
   335	    totalPages
   336	  };
