codex
The defects come from two layers disagreeing: native scanning returns a bounded, flat snapshot, while Session History groups, searches, and pages that snapshot in the browser. A correct project→worktree hierarchy with reliable counts and previews requires a richer backend session index/query plus corresponding nested UI state, not only markup changes (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:136-219`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:96-121`).

## 1. Data path and extracted fields

- **[Verified] Native `/next` scans Tauri first, then falls back to the local bridge.** `scanRail()` calls `listAgentSessionsFromTauri()` and then `listAgentSessionsFromLocalBridge()` (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/routes/next/+page.svelte:770-790`; `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/tauriSource.ts:1015-1025`).

- **[Verified] The Tauri command directly returns `Vec<AgentSessionRecord>` from `scan_sessions`; it has no query, grouping, search, or paging parameters.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src-tauri/src/main.rs:1371-1376`).

- **[Verified] The Rust scanner reads:**
  - Codex rollout files under `~/.codex/sessions` and `~/.codex/archived_sessions` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:151-187`).
  - Codex `~/.codex/session_index.jsonl` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:171-175`).
  - CMUX hook-session JSON under `~/.cmuxterm` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:189-194`).
  - Claude JSONL under `~/.claude/projects` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:196-213`).

- **[Verified] The serialized record contains provider, native ID, title, description, model, project path, last activity, resume commands, derived hints, `message_count`, and `latest_turn_preview`. It contains no `first_prompt` or full latest-turn collection.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:37-88`).

- **[Verified] Codex index rows provide only ID, thread name, updated timestamp, model, and resume command; `project_path`, `message_count`, and preview are initially empty.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:239-270`).

- **[Verified] Codex rollout parsing reads `session_meta`, `turn_context`, and `response_item` records; it derives a first prompt temporarily, counts conversation turns, and retains only the latest preview.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:275-406`).

- **[Verified] Claude parsing reads session ID, timestamps, cwd, title/description, model, and transcript turns; it also derives a first prompt temporarily, counts turns, and retains only the latest preview.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:754-852`).

- **[Verified] The scanner reads bounded windows, not complete transcripts: Codex uses bounded head/tail reads and Claude uses a bounded tail read.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:8-35`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:178-184`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:203-213`).

- **[Verified] The final scanner result is sorted and truncated before reaching the UI.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:216-219`).

## 2. Defect A: “6 messages” versus “2760 msgs”

- **[Verified] Session History rows display `SessionLibraryRecord.messageCount`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:160-162`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:383-386`).

- **[Verified] Provider records take that count from the scanned `AgentSession.messageCount`; owned records take it from persisted `OwnedSession.messageCount`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:144-167`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:170-194`).

- **[Verified] The expanded left-rail card also reads `OwnedSession.messageCount`; expansion does not reread the transcript.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/components/sessions/SessionCard.svelte:95-104`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/components/sessions/SessionCard.svelte:162-165`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/components/sessions/sessionCardModel.ts:114-117`).

- **[Verified] Owned sessions are copied from a scan at adoption and then persisted in local storage; scanned `available` sessions are refreshed and not persisted.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/ownedSessions.ts:137-165`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:44-48`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:78-84`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:186-188`).

- **[Verified] The scanner’s count is only a bounded floor, not a transcript total.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:62-83`).

- **[Assumed] In the screenshot, “6” is the current bounded scanner value while “2760” is a stale or independently persisted owned-session value.** The exact runtime objects cannot be proven from source alone, but the code exposes precisely these two authorities and does not synchronize them on expansion (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:202-235`).

- **[Verified] Owned records are considered first and suppress an available record only when `(provider, nativeSessionId, canonicalCwd)` matches. A cwd/project-path mismatch can therefore leave two representations of one native session.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:102-118`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:202-235`).

## 3. Defect B: duplicate “rental-management” groups

- **[Verified] Group identity is the full normalized path, not the displayed label.** `groupSessionHistory()` uses `sessionProjectPath(record)` as the map key (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:358-376`).

- **[Verified] `sessionProjectPath()` prefers `projectPath`, otherwise `canonicalCwd`; `canonicalCwd()` only normalizes separators, repeated slashes, trailing slash, and drive-letter case. It does not resolve repository roots or worktrees.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:85-96`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:293-295`).

- **[Verified] The visible group name is only the final path segment.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:352-355`).

- **[Assumed] Two distinct paths such as `/.../rental-management` and `/.../worktrees/rental-management` therefore produce two different groups with the identical label `rental-management`.** This is the direct consequence of the verified key/label split.

- **[Verified] The current backend record has only one path field, `project_path`; it does not provide separate repository/project-root and worktree fields.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:39-48`).

## 4. Defect C: group counts versus reachable rows

- **[Verified] The UI computes `allGroups` from the complete filtered/sorted list, but computes rendered `groups` from only `page.items`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:110-121`).

- **[Verified] Group badges use counts from `allGroups`, while rows come from page-local `groups`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:345-350`).

- **[Verified] Pagination slices the ordered list to the configured page size, defaulting to 50.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:24-37`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:320-336`).

- **[Verified] The footer reports page-local rows against the pre-page total.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:444-453`).

- **[Verified] Therefore “75” can be the full group count while only one or nine rows from that group are present on the current page; the same group can reappear on another page.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:118-121`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:345-352`).

## 5. Defect D: first prompt availability

- **[Verified] The exact placeholder is rendered at `SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:419`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:415-420`).

- **[Verified] `SessionLibraryRecord.firstPrompt` is explicitly populated as `null` for both owned and provider records.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:144-167`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:170-194`).

- **[Verified] Rust does extract a first prompt internally, but only uses it to derive a fallback title; it never serializes a first-prompt field.** Codex (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:359-363`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:397-403`); Claude (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:777-779`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:840-848`).

- **[Verified] Therefore the Session History first-prompt feature is unimplemented at the record/schema boundary, not lazy in the UI.**

- **[Verified] Some prompts can additionally be missed because only bounded transcript windows are scanned.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:19-27`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:203-213`).

## 6. Search behavior and misses

- **[Verified] Search is a client-side filter over the already-fetched `owned` plus `available` arrays.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:96-110`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:277-290`).

- **[Verified] The search text includes title, description, provider, model, project path, cwd, native ID, state, message count, and latest-turn preview; it does not include `firstPrompt` or a complete transcript.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:239-255`).

- **[Verified] Filtering occurs before pagination, so search is not limited to the current 50-row page; it is limited to the finite scanner snapshot.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:110-118`).

- **[Verified] Sessions outside the scanner’s file/result budgets, sessions absent from the current rescan, and prompts not present in title/description/latest preview cannot be found.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:8-35`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:216-219`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:239-255`).

- **[Verified] There is no backend search query at this boundary; the native command returns an unfiltered vector.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src-tauri/src/main.rs:1371-1376`).

## 7. Where regrouping and rich previews must happen

### Frontend touchpoints

- **[Verified] Data model changes belong in `sessionLibraryModel.ts`:** add distinct project-root/repository and worktree identities, nested group types, and preview fields (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:21-83`).

- **[Verified] Grouping/rendering changes belong in `SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte`:** current flat grouping, page derivation, count badges, and row rendering are all here (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:96-121`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:345-439`).

- **[Verified] Collapse state does not exist for project groups.** The store has only one `expandedKey`/`selectedKey` for a session row (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:8-22`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:56-64`), and the group heading is a noninteractive `<div>` (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:346-350`).

- **[Verified] Rich previews currently have only one `latestTurnPreview` converted into one synthetic turn; `firstPrompt` remains null.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:140-142`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:162-164`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:189-191`).

### Backend/index touchpoints

- **[Verified] The current backend is a filesystem scanner, not a session database/query layer.** It reads JSONL files and returns a vector directly (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:136-219`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src-tauri/src/main.rs:1371-1376`).

- **[Assumed] A correct two-level project→worktree design would need a durable session index containing at least:** provider/native ID, project/repository root, worktree path, title, first prompt, rich latest turns, message count, and timestamps.

- **[Assumed] Ingestion would need to scan complete transcripts or maintain offsets/cursors so previews and counts are not bounded-window guesses.**

- **[Assumed] The backend query should apply search/filters/scopes, then compute per-project and per-worktree counts with database-side `GROUP BY project_root, worktree_path`, and only then apply row paging. The client should receive groups/counts plus rows, rather than grouping a 50-row slice itself.**

- **[Assumed] The existing `usage_db` SQLite code is not currently the session-history authority; a session-specific index/table and Tauri query command would be required rather than reusing the present filesystem vector unchanged.**

## Root causes ranked by user impact

1. **[Verified] Data is bounded and split between rescanned provider records and persisted owned records, producing wrong counts and incomplete search.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:62-83`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:44-48`)

2. **[Verified] Group counts are calculated before paging while rows are rendered after paging.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:118-121`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:320-336`)

3. **[Verified] Groups key by full path but display only the basename, so different worktrees/repositories receive identical labels.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:352-376`)

4. **[Verified] First prompts are discarded at the backend/UI boundary; the placeholder is intentional behavior for a missing field.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:397-403`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:162-191`)

5. **[Verified] Project headers have no collapse state or interaction; only individual session rows can expand.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:18-20`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:346-350`)

- **[Verified] The Rust scanner reads:**
  - Codex rollout files under `~/.codex/sessions` and `~/.codex/archived_sessions` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:151-187`).
  - Codex `~/.codex/session_index.jsonl` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:171-175`).
  - CMUX hook-session JSON under `~/.cmuxterm` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:189-194`).
  - Claude JSONL under `~/.claude/projects` (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:196-213`).

- **[Verified] The serialized record contains provider, native ID, title, description, model, project path, last activity, resume commands, derived hints, `message_count`, and `latest_turn_preview`. It contains no `first_prompt` or full latest-turn collection.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:37-88`).

- **[Verified] Codex index rows provide only ID, thread name, updated timestamp, model, and resume command; `project_path`, `message_count`, and preview are initially empty.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:239-270`).

- **[Verified] Codex rollout parsing reads `session_meta`, `turn_context`, and `response_item` records; it derives a first prompt temporarily, counts conversation turns, and retains only the latest preview.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:275-406`).

- **[Verified] Claude parsing reads session ID, timestamps, cwd, title/description, model, and transcript turns; it also derives a first prompt temporarily, counts turns, and retains only the latest preview.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:754-852`).

- **[Verified] The scanner reads bounded windows, not complete transcripts: Codex uses bounded head/tail reads and Claude uses a bounded tail read.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:8-35`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:178-184`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:203-213`).

- **[Verified] The final scanner result is sorted and truncated before reaching the UI.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:216-219`).

## 2. Defect A: “6 messages” versus “2760 msgs”

- **[Verified] Session History rows display `SessionLibraryRecord.messageCount`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:160-162`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:383-386`).

- **[Verified] Provider records take that count from the scanned `AgentSession.messageCount`; owned records take it from persisted `OwnedSession.messageCount`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:144-167`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:170-194`).

- **[Verified] The expanded left-rail card also reads `OwnedSession.messageCount`; expansion does not reread the transcript.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/components/sessions/SessionCard.svelte:95-104`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/components/sessions/SessionCard.svelte:162-165`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/components/sessions/sessionCardModel.ts:114-117`).

- **[Verified] Owned sessions are copied from a scan at adoption and then persisted in local storage; scanned `available` sessions are refreshed and not persisted.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/ownedSessions.ts:137-165`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:44-48`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:78-84`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:186-188`).

- **[Verified] The scanner’s count is only a bounded floor, not a transcript total.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:62-83`).

- **[Assumed] In the screenshot, “6” is the current bounded scanner value while “2760” is a stale or independently persisted owned-session value.** The exact runtime objects cannot be proven from source alone, but the code exposes precisely these two authorities and does not synchronize them on expansion (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:202-235`).

- **[Verified] Owned records are considered first and suppress an available record only when `(provider, nativeSessionId, canonicalCwd)` matches. A cwd/project-path mismatch can therefore leave two representations of one native session.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:102-118`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:202-235`).

## 3. Defect B: duplicate “rental-management” groups

- **[Verified] Group identity is the full normalized path, not the displayed label.** `groupSessionHistory()` uses `sessionProjectPath(record)` as the map key (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:358-376`).

- **[Verified] `sessionProjectPath()` prefers `projectPath`, otherwise `canonicalCwd`; `canonicalCwd()` only normalizes separators, repeated slashes, trailing slash, and drive-letter case. It does not resolve repository roots or worktrees.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:85-96`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:293-295`).

- **[Verified] The visible group name is only the final path segment.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:352-355`).

- **[Assumed] Two distinct paths such as `/.../rental-management` and `/.../worktrees/rental-management` therefore produce two different groups with the identical label `rental-management`.** This is the direct consequence of the verified key/label split.

- **[Verified] The current backend record has only one path field, `project_path`; it does not provide separate repository/project-root and worktree fields.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:39-48`).

## 4. Defect C: group counts versus reachable rows

- **[Verified] The UI computes `allGroups` from the complete filtered/sorted list, but computes rendered `groups` from only `page.items`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:110-121`).

- **[Verified] Group badges use counts from `allGroups`, while rows come from page-local `groups`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:345-350`).

- **[Verified] Pagination slices the ordered list to the configured page size, defaulting to 50.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:24-37`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:320-336`).

- **[Verified] The footer reports page-local rows against the pre-page total.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:444-453`).

- **[Verified] Therefore “75” can be the full group count while only one or nine rows from that group are present on the current page; the same group can reappear on another page.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:118-121`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:345-352`).

## 5. Defect D: first prompt availability

- **[Verified] The exact placeholder is rendered at `SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:419`.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:415-420`).

- **[Verified] `SessionLibraryRecord.firstPrompt` is explicitly populated as `null` for both owned and provider records.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:144-167`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:170-194`).

- **[Verified] Rust does extract a first prompt internally, but only uses it to derive a fallback title; it never serializes a first-prompt field.** Codex (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:359-363`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:397-403`); Claude (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:777-779`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:840-848`).

- **[Verified] Therefore the Session History first-prompt feature is unimplemented at the record/schema boundary, not lazy in the UI.**

- **[Verified] Some prompts can additionally be missed because only bounded transcript windows are scanned.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:19-27`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:203-213`).

## 6. Search behavior and misses

- **[Verified] Search is a client-side filter over the already-fetched `owned` plus `available` arrays.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:96-110`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:277-290`).

- **[Verified] The search text includes title, description, provider, model, project path, cwd, native ID, state, message count, and latest-turn preview; it does not include `firstPrompt` or a complete transcript.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:239-255`).

- **[Verified] Filtering occurs before pagination, so search is not limited to the current 50-row page; it is limited to the finite scanner snapshot.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:110-118`).

- **[Verified] Sessions outside the scanner’s file/result budgets, sessions absent from the current rescan, and prompts not present in title/description/latest preview cannot be found.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:8-35`, `core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:216-219`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:239-255`).

- **[Verified] There is no backend search query at this boundary; the native command returns an unfiltered vector.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src-tauri/src/main.rs:1371-1376`).

## 7. Where regrouping and rich previews must happen

### Frontend touchpoints

- **[Verified] Data model changes belong in `sessionLibraryModel.ts`:** add distinct project-root/repository and worktree identities, nested group types, and preview fields (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:21-83`).

- **[Verified] Grouping/rendering changes belong in `SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte`:** current flat grouping, page derivation, count badges, and row rendering are all here (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:96-121`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:345-439`).

- **[Verified] Collapse state does not exist for project groups.** The store has only one `expandedKey`/`selectedKey` for a session row (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:8-22`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:56-64`), and the group heading is a noninteractive `<div>` (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:346-350`).

- **[Verified] Rich previews currently have only one `latestTurnPreview` converted into one synthetic turn; `firstPrompt` remains null.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:140-142`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:162-164`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:189-191`).

### Backend/index touchpoints

- **[Verified] The current backend is a filesystem scanner, not a session database/query layer.** It reads JSONL files and returns a vector directly (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:136-219`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src-tauri/src/main.rs:1371-1376`).

- **[Assumed] A correct two-level project→worktree design would need a durable session index containing at least:** provider/native ID, project/repository root, worktree path, title, first prompt, rich latest turns, message count, and timestamps.

- **[Assumed] Ingestion would need to scan complete transcripts or maintain offsets/cursors so previews and counts are not bounded-window guesses.**

- **[Assumed] The backend query should apply search/filters/scopes, then compute per-project and per-worktree counts with database-side `GROUP BY project_root, worktree_path`, and only then apply row paging. The client should receive groups/counts plus rows, rather than grouping a 50-row slice itself.**

- **[Assumed] The existing `usage_db` SQLite code is not currently the session-history authority; a session-specific index/table and Tauri query command would be required rather than reusing the present filesystem vector unchanged.**

## Root causes ranked by user impact

1. **[Verified] Data is bounded and split between rescanned provider records and persisted owned records, producing wrong counts and incomplete search.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:62-83`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/stores/sessionRailStore.svelte.ts:44-48`)

2. **[Verified] Group counts are calculated before paging while rows are rendered after paging.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:118-121`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:320-336`)

3. **[Verified] Groups key by full path but display only the basename, so different worktrees/repositories receive identical labels.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:352-376`)

4. **[Verified] First prompts are discarded at the backend/UI boundary; the placeholder is intentional behavior for a missing field.** (`core/src/scanners/sessions.rs:397-403`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryModel.ts:162-191`)

5. **[Verified] Project headers have no collapse state or interaction; only individual session rows can expand.** (`tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/sessionLibraryStore.svelte.ts:18-20`, `tauri-svelte-preview/src/lib/shell/sessionLibrary/SessionLibraryWorkspace.svelte:346-350`)
